source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 5, Algorithm 1 and Theorem 1; p. 7, Conclusion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: M-ID takes a monotonicity-annotated causal graph, counterfactual terms, and available distributions; it is stated sound, and the conclusion calls a complete necessary-and-sufficient algorithm under monotonicity an open question.

The conditional reduction is given in Lemma 3 and Theorem 6 states that CTFID returns an expression if and only if the conditional counterfactual is identifiable from the graph and arbitrary observational/interventional menu.
The published record identifies AMWNs as complete for counterfactual independences via d-separation and describes a three-rule ctf-calculus.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: CTFIDU+ is stated sound and complete for its unrestricted input class, while the converse construction uses independent binary latents and mod-two parent sums.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2-4, Definition 2.3, Theorem 2.4, Proposition 2.5, and Theorem 2.8
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a finite canonical SCM class preserving every counterfactual distribution in an arbitrary discrete SCM, with each exogenous support bounded by the product of unrestricted response-function counts in its c-component, and reduces bounds to polynomial programming.
The article reduces discrete causal questions to polynomial programming and uses dual relaxation and spatial branch-and-bound to obtain sharp bounds.
The paper develops estimators for identified hidden-variable graphical effects and states that a complete identification algorithm can yield a weight-based estimation strategy.

source_verification_receipts.locator: model definition discussion near the beginning of the paper
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Recursive semi-Markovian models are described as acyclic models with independent exogenous variables, each used in at most two structural functions.

State a conventional input-size and bit-complexity bound alongside the response-type bound, separating the finite oracle's CAD complexity from the proposed calculus's memoized-cell complexity.
Extend the inference layer to branch ties through a directional delta method and resampling procedure, rather than excluding all empirical ties by the local analytic-margin condition.
